name: dao-browser
description: Let Codex work in the user's Dao browser: background task windows with the user's sign-ins that the user can watch and take over.

interface.shortDescription: Work in the user's Dao browser
interface.longDescription: Run multi-step browser tasks in Dao's background task windows, which use the user's sign-ins without touching their tabs. The user can watch every task from Dao's sidebar and take over at any time.
defaultPrompt: Use dao-browser to open https://example.com in a background task and report its title.
